name: attention-ablation
title: 大语言模型实验：手写缩放点积注意力 + 三档消融 + 下一个 token 的采样

assertions.name: token 序列与高频繁词报对（n_tokens / n_unique_tokens / top_terms）
assertions.expr: out.tokens.n_tokens === expected.tokens.n_tokens && out.tokens.n_unique_tokens === expected.tokens.n_unique_tokens && JSON.stringify(out.tokens.top_terms) === JSON.stringify(expected.tokens.top_terms)

assertions.name: 注意力矩阵形状正确且每行权重和为 1
assertions.expr: JSON.stringify(out.attention.shape) === JSON.stringify(expected.attention.shape) && Array.isArray(out.attention.row_sums) && out.attention.row_sums.length === out.attention.shape[0] && out.attention.row_sums.every((s) => typeof s === 'number' && Math.abs(s - 1) < 1e-6)

assertions.name: 因果掩码真的生效（上三角全为 0）
注意力权重口径一致（attn_checksum 逐字节可比）
每个位置最关注的 token 正确（top_attend 逐项）
三档消融的数值正确（max_row_weight / entropy，容差 1e-3）
assertions.expr: ['full','no_scale','no_mask'].every((v) => { const a = out.ablation.find((x) => x.variant === v); const e = expected.ablation.find((x) => x.variant === v); return a && e && Math.abs(a.max_row_weight - e.max_row_weight) < 1e-3 && Math.abs(a.entropy - e.entropy) < 1e-3; })

assertions.name: 消融方向成立：去掉 √d 缩放后分布更尖（最大行权重更大、行熵更低）
assertions.expr: out.ablation.find((x) => x.variant === 'no_scale').max_row_weight > out.ablation.find((x) => x.variant === 'full').max_row_weight && out.ablation.find((x) => x.variant === 'no_scale').entropy < out.ablation.find((x) => x.variant === 'full').entropy

assertions.name: 去掉因果掩码后确实看到了未来（未来权重 > 0，完整版与去缩放版为 0）
assertions.expr: out.ablation.find((x) => x.variant === 'no_mask').mean_future_weight > 0 && Math.abs(out.ablation.find((x) => x.variant === 'full').mean_future_weight) < 1e-6 && Math.abs(out.ablation.find((x) => x.variant === 'no_scale').mean_future_weight) < 1e-6

assertions.name: 下一个 token 的基础分布与前 5 次采样逐项一致
assertions.expr: out.sampling.top1_token === expected.sampling.top1_token && Math.abs(out.sampling.top1_prob - expected.sampling.top1_prob) < 1e-3 && Math.abs(out.sampling.entropy - expected.sampling.entropy) < 1e-3 && JSON.stringify(out.sampling.scales.map((s) => [s.scale, s.top1_token, s.samples])) === JSON.stringify(expected.sampling.scales.map((s) => [s.scale, s.top1_token, s.samples]))

assertions.name: 各锐化系数下的 top-1 概率、行熵与实测 top1_ratio 正确
assertions.expr: out.sampling.scales.length === expected.sampling.scales.length && expected.sampling.scales.every((e, i) => Math.abs(out.sampling.scales[i].top1_prob - e.top1_prob) < 1e-3 && Math.abs(out.sampling.scales[i].entropy - e.entropy) < 1e-3 && Math.abs(out.sampling.scales[i].top1_ratio - e.top1_ratio) < 1e-3)

assertions.name: 采样方向成立：锐化系数越大，top-1 概率与实测占比越低
assertions.expr: out.sampling.scales.every((s, i, a) => i === 0 || (a[i - 1].top1_prob > s.top1_prob && a[i - 1].top1_ratio > s.top1_ratio))

assertions.name: 图与说明齐全（至少 2 张，各含一句话结论）
assertions.expr: Array.isArray(out.figures) && out.figures.length >= 2 && out.figures.every((f) => f && typeof f.path === 'string' && f.path.trim() !== '' && typeof f.takeaway === 'string' && f.takeaway.trim().length >= 10)

assertions.name: 说清机制与边界（notes ≥ 60 字）
